name: Keyboard Remapper
author: houz42
description: Evdev-level key remaps via keyd: tap/hold overloads, plain maps, and swaps. Add/remove rules right from the popup (written to gitignored user-rules.json) or edit rules.json directly. Ships with one example: tap the physical Alt key alone to emit F12 (for herdr's prefix), while holding Alt still works as a normal modifier. Also shows the compositor's live XKB options with double-map warnings, and can edit them or migrate them into keyd rules.

barWidget.description: Toggle keyd tap/hold remap rules from the bar.
